description: Test suite for building and resolving Telegram inline buttons and interactive button blocks, verifying correct mapping and behavior according to Telegram constraints.

methods.name: buildTelegramInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Constructs Telegram inline button rows from shared button and select blocks, filtering out those exceeding Telegram's size limits.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInlineButtons
methods.description: Resolves inline buttons either from explicit input or by deriving from interactive block payloads.

ctags.name: explicit
ctags.pattern: /^    const explicit = [[{ text: "Keep", callback_data: "keep" }]] as const;$/
